assertion.statement: From an absolutely irreducible r whose restriction to G_K is reducible, obtain r=Ind(theta_bar), finite image of order prime to3, and the ordered local normalization by delta.
assertion.objects: G_Q, K=Q(sqrt(-3)), finite k/ F_3, chosen G_Q3 and quotient chi2
assertion.hypotheses: r is odd and absolutely irreducible; r|G_K and r|G_Q3 are reducible
assertion.quantifiers: every such r and either specified local quotient
assertion.parameter_range: p=3; coefficient fields may be enlarged finitely
assertion.uniformity: same global delta and same specified quotient throughout
assertion.exceptional_cases: global dihedrality without local reducibility is not enough
assertion.limit_order: finite number-field extension and localization precede completion; reduction is taken at the chosen place; no analytic or inverse limit is used
